1. Mr. M.S. Pal, learned Senior Advocate 
assisted by Ms. Medha Pande, learned 
counsel for the applicants.
2. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. Pursuant to the previous order dated 
09.07.2024, S.I. Narendra Kumar, who was 
the investigating officer of FIR No. 19 of 
2024 as well as FIR No. 80 of 2024 is 
present in Court. In FIR No. 19 of 2024, 
charge sheet has been filed on 26.04.2024, 
however, investigation of FIR No. 80 of 
2024 is still going on.
4. Let concerned I.O. who is present in 
Court file his affidavit to justify why the 
investigation of both the FIR which pertains 
to same incident has not been carried out 
collectively.
5. Put up this matter on 18.07.2024 after 
fresh.
6. Personal appearance of the officer 
concerned is exempted.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
